people.name: Trent Robert White
people.bio_note: Founded Luminvest in June 2023 after more than a decade advising high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth families. Immediately prior, he spent about 3.5 years (Dec 2019-June 2023) as a Senior Wealth Advisor for Ultra High Net Worth clients at Vanguard's Personal Advisor Services, where he managed a book exceeding $1 billion in assets across roughly 150 UHNW households — a notably large individual book even by UHNW-advisor standards. He holds a JD from BYU's J. Reuben Clark Law School and an Executive LLM in Taxation with an Estate Planning Certificate from Georgetown University Law Center, on top of a BS in Financial Economics from BYU and his CFP designation. Earlier career included work as a tax preparer and life insurance agent. He's a NAPFA member and has said he left the wirehouse/broker-dealer model specifically to remove conflicts with his fiduciary duty to clients — consistent with Luminvest's conflict-free positioning. No press coverage, speaking engagements, or industry awards found for him individually.
people.bio_source: luminvest.com/about (firm's own website states the specific figure of managing over $1 billion in assets across roughly 150 UHNW households during his time at Vanguard). His broader Vanguard tenure and role are independently corroborated via NAPFA and other advisor-directory sources. Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the specific $1B/150-household figures could not be independently confirmed anywhere (Vanguard does not publicly disclose individual-advisor book sizes) -- treat that specific figure as firm-stated, not independently verified.

firm_note.text: Independent, fee-only RIA in Scottsdale founded June 2023 by Trent White after a career managing ultra-high-net-worth relationships at Vanguard. Positions itself as a comprehensive wealth planning firm for retirees, with a low-cost, tax-focused, conflict-free model (no product sales or referral fee revenue) covering investments, taxes, insurance, estate planning, and life planning. Member of NAPFA (fee-only fiduciary standard) and listed in the Paladin Registry. No third-party press, awards, or rankings found for the firm itself beyond standard industry directory listings.
firm_note.source: Firm website (luminvest.com/about, /); web search for firm press/awards across Forbes, business journals, NAPFA, Paladin Registry — no independent recognition found beyond directory/membership listings.
